description: Replace `tryAutoApproval` with a single shared `applyAtRunEnd` call site after the terminal handlers in `Execute()`. Add the eager provenance write at sandbox setup, wire `RunOutcome.ToContract` (7→4 mapping), remove the deprecated legacy fields (`SandboxAcceptanceConfig.AutoApprove` / `AutoReject` / `DisableAutoApproveIfEmpty`, `RunConfig.RequiresApproval`), update proto + generated code, fix `orchestration/sandbox_config_test.go` fixtures, and write the six plan-specified run-executor test cases (success-apply, failure-apply, partial-acceptance split, manualReview-deferred, no-op empty-provenance, ConversationID inheritance). This is the load-bearing cut that flips behavior end-to-end. Locked contract reference: `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract`.
